title: Choose the visual world
question: Re-roll 1 — prior hand retired. New assignment: Broadcast Ident. Emigre Bitmap won the weighing on both axes.

options.label: Broadcast Ident
options.lineage: TV channel idents / bumpers — a signature sting, then the programme
options.thesis: Craft announces itself in a short motion ident; then recruiters enter the programme of demos.
options.viewport: First seconds: name + role as a channel ident sting; then cut to the programme — oversized live demo as the show.
options.risk: Motion-first can feel like splash-page theatre if the sting outlasts patience.

raised.raise: Career history readable as layered strata beneath the programme, not a flat timeline.
Visited sections leave a short afterimage trail — history of the walk.
Scroll cadence arrests at section ends like glaze freezing mid-pour.

options.label: Contact Sheet
options.lineage: darkroom contact sheets — frames selected, then enlarged
options.thesis: Projects sit as proof frames on a contact sheet; open one to enlarge the live demo.
options.viewport: Grid of demo frames with grease-pencil selects; one frame enlarges into the live work.
options.risk: Also a familiar craft-portfolio move — safe if the marks stay decorative.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.lineage: Emigre bitmap type specimens — coarse pixels proud at poster scale
options.thesis: React/Next craft shown as a digital type specimen: demos repeat at size steps, pixels honest.
options.viewport: Headline in coarse bitmap at poster scale; demos as the same craft repeated at five sizes; live open is the smooth cut.
options.case: Wins both axes — tech hiring identifies with pixel-honest digital craft; specimen layout makes live demos the proof.
options.risk: Nostalgia trap if bitmap stays costume instead of system.

options.label: Marker Zine
options.lineage: hand-drawn technical zine — napkin diagrams that teach hard things
options.thesis: A friend walks the recruiter through craft with marker callouts; demos are the diagrams that open live.
options.viewport: Hand-lettered name; doodle arrows into the first live demo panel.
options.case: Holds approachable identification; loses on polish clarity against demos that must look shipped.
options.risk: Sketch charm can undercut ‘production craft’ proof.

options.label: Torn Billboard
options.lineage: décollage — torn poster layers exposing older campaigns
options.case: Recruiters lose the scan path inside accidental tear composition.
options.kept: Career as layered strata under the surface.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.case: Demos are not terminal text; drifts into category-cliché developer skin.

options.label: Indoor Sun
options.lineage: monofrequency indoor weather sun in a mirrored hall
options.case: Atmosphere overwhelms employers, demos, and contact.

options.label: Kiln Shelf
options.lineage: glaze-river cups on a kiln shelf
options.case: Ceramics metaphor does not map live web demos for hiring managers.
options.kept: Arrested flow as scroll cadence at section ends.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Centered intro, skill pills, experience timeline, project card grid, contact form — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Avatar + name + Contact CTA, then familiar section stack.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other frontend portfolios by design.
